correctness.rationale: Two centres with equal support produce a coordinate line; disjoint supports exclude any third centre; intersecting supports uniquely give the third support-pair centre, so all rich lines are classified. The restriction H_d=(s+t)^d+(-1)^d(s^d+t^d) has derivative common roots only at primitive cube roots, occurring iff d=1 mod 3; at both, H!=0. The projective infinity point has no repeated root, including odd d when the polynomial has degree d-1 in x. Smoothness of the corresponding plane Fermat section implies no shared tangency contact on distinct lines with equal support triple. Orbit-stabilizer yields the stated count. Exact independent polynomial GCD checks d=4..16 passed; proof covers every d and N.
